content.text:
I scrolled past the "לבחירה עצמית" section; the screen cut off the card headings and I only caught bits like "קונים, מוכרים ומחזיקים מניות".
"במה הכסף מושקע": there's "מדד S&P 500", the thing my friends talk about! "הכסף מושקע בדולרים דרך קרן שעוקבת אחריו". OK.
The others say "חשיפה לדולר או מנוטרלת ממנו"? No idea what that means.
There are lots of cards with no numbers anywhere: no fees, nothing about how much it went up. The page just ends with "מה האתר עוד לא מכסה".

**What I'd tell my friend:**
Fairly clear now, but I haven't decided anything. The page splits it into two parts. One is where the money is held: bank, קרן השתלמות, קופת גמל להשקעה, or an account at a bank or investment house. The other is what it's invested in: cash, קרן כספית, מק"מ, or an index like the S&P 500. What clicked for me is that "S&P" isn't a place you go to, it's something you put inside one of those. So the things worth checking for me are the S&P 500 through a fund that tracks it, maybe inside the קרן השתלמות I already have, or that קופת גמל להשקעה you can apparently take money out of whenever you want. A קרן כספית could be for money I need to keep handy. But the page gave me no fees and no numbers, so I don't know which one is cheaper or better.

**How it went:**
- I read the top heading "מדריך", then "שני חלקים בכל חיסכון", then the "מאיפה להתחיל" links.
- I only caught the end of the cards in "כסף שוטף וקצר" (something about ריבית).
- I read the קרן השתלמות and קופת גמל להשקעה cards.
- I scrolled past "פרישה" and "לילדים".
- In "לבחירה עצמית" the headings were cut off by the scroll, so I don't know what those cards were called.
- In "במה הכסף מושקע" I stopped on the S&P 500 card and skimmed the other index cards.
- Words I didn't get: "קרן חדשה מקיפה", "מק"מ", "חשיפה לדולר או מנוטרלת ממנו", "קרן נאמנות", "תגמולים", the "יומית / מתחדשת" buttons, "MSCI".
- What annoyed me: lots of cards that all look the same, no fee in shekels, and no "here's what we suggest for someone like you". I'd have closed it after the index cards.
